headline: Sensex and Nifty trade higher ahead of RBI rate decision; Glenmark and Reliance in focus

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Positive global cues from Wall Street and Nikkei boosted investor sentiment
Markets are trading higher in anticipation of the upcoming RBI repo rate announcement
Falling oil prices have contributed to the positive momentum in the domestic market
Gains in heavyweights like Reliance Industries and banking stocks supported the indices
whatHappening: Sensex rose over 300 points while Nifty 50 topped the 22,600 level
The GST Council meeting has been rescheduled to take place on October 8
Gold prices dropped by Rs 1,500 per 10g over two days amid a strong dollar
Glenmark Pharmaceuticals launched new pump packs for its adapalene gel in the US market
summary: Indian benchmark indices opened higher today, with the Sensex and Nifty 50 showing strong gains ahead of the RBI's repo rate decision. Global market strength and falling oil prices have provided a favorable environment for domestic equities. Key stocks like Reliance Industries, Asian Paints, and Bharti Airtel are leading the market's upward movement.
